scope: Pre-event host CPU research. Fresh informed-author synthetic wording after locking one compact-digit candidate; not human-blind, independent user/ASR sampling or evidence of general accuracy. No captures/results exist at protocol creation.
authoring_gate: Parent must lock candidate class/prompt/grammar/map/MAX_TOKENS and explicitly authorize fresh corpus before requests are authored.

fixed.baseline_validation: JSON object contains only intent, an allowed string label, plus native reached_eos true
fixed.candidate_validation: Raw text exactly one ASCII digit 0 through 6, without trimming, plus native reached_eos true
fixed.candidate_identity_note: Bound in separate freeze manifest before authoring; null is prospective, not an unfrozen execution permission.

freeze_before_capture: baseline and selected candidate adapter bytes/rendered examples/prompt/grammar/max_tokens/map
generator, complete cases/labels and ordered requests
all prior/example/development overlap inventory hashes and extraction methods

corpus.contract: One immediate focus start/resume/pause/status/nudge explanation; one unambiguous alarm (colon or explicit AM/PM English); integer focus/timer 1..7200 seconds or 1..120 minutes; one approved Settings/Calculator/Clock open. Negated/compound/conditional/quoted/reported/hypothetical/destructive/payment/message/unapproved/unrelated/ambiguous/invalid/calendar/repeated/multiple/signed/fractional/out-of-range/extra-modifier/existing-action-cancel/injection requests require UNKNOWN. Keep known hard current-focus pause and warned-focus explanation as fresh rows even if unchanged gate abstains.

overlap.normalize: Lowercase, replace runs outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with spaces, collapse whitespace; no semantic, paraphrase or number-word normalization.
overlap.additional_required: Locked candidate rendered examples/development fixtures and other known command fixtures; bind exact paths/hashes/extraction before corpus freeze. Missing mandatory inventory stops generation.

corpus.publication: Raw corpus/requests/output/details remain ignored; tracked hashes/counts/aggregate metrics only. Generator may reproduce the synthetic corpus; never commit generated raw data.

execution.row_order: Same frozen stable row order in both arms
execution.state: Clear native recurrent/KV state for every request
execution.incomplete: Preserve outputs/metadata and report missing IDs; no reduced-denominator confirmation or restart as unseen data.
execution.gate: Same actual compiled current gate/parser receives complete original utterance and validated mapped semantic intent; oracle domain route once and identical across arms.
execution.invalid_output: No semantic prediction, so semantic failure even on unknown; route to gate UNKNOWN and separately count invalid-output fallback abstention.

metrics.timing_limit: Descriptive host-only sequential baseline-first capture with separate loads, unflushed OS cache and uncontrolled thermals/power. Not measured phone/NPU/device energy, activation overhead or app speedup.

necessary_for_review: Strictly more correct supported complete gate proposals
Zero observed wrong accepts among supported and unsupported rows
Zero paired semantic or full-gate losses on prospectively tagged hard supported rows
Per-intent and all other supported losses fully disclosed; any per-intent decrease rejected or separately reviewed as a tradeoff
Prompt-token and latency tradeoff reported even when coverage improves
promotion.limits: 100 informed synthetic rows cannot prove universal safety/general accuracy or promote deployment. Root decision, broader language/voice evaluation, real phone regressions and device costs remain separate prerequisites; preserve rejected/uncertain outcome.
